text:
Eli: Quick personal share — Sam and I got married last weekend! 🥂 We’ll swing by the office Friday for a tiny celebration (kitchen, 3pm). Would love to see whoever can make it. ❤️
Sam: ahh thank you all!! Really excited. No presents necessary, but if folks ask here's our registry: https://registry.example.com/sam-eli and Venmo is `@sam.pay` if you prefer to chip in for flowers.
Asha: OMG congrats!! :tada: can we do a cake flavor poll? chocolate / lemon / vanilla
Marco: chocolate :chocolate_bar: 100%
Priya: voting lemon! bright and spring-y 🌼
Noor: vanilla + extra buttercream please :buttercream:
Mira: i can bring savory bites (mini quiches) and a card. where should i leave the card?
Eli: Mira — drop cards at reception or DM me and I'll grab them. thank you!!
Asha: tiny signup so we don't duplicate stuff — lmk what you want to bring.
Asha: ```
Friday 3pm — Kitchen celebration
- Asha: cake (chocolate)
- Marco: plates + forks
- Mira: savory snacks (quiches)
- Priya: drinks
- Noor: card + confetti (lol)
- Lina: napkins + forks
```
calendar-bot: Event created — "Sam & Eli: Office Toast" Fri 15:00 — Kitchen (organizer: Eli)
Lina: i can pick up flowers too, happy to cover $25 if anyone wants to split (Venmo works).
